candidates.text: Do not load the same external resource via both CSS @import and an HTML <link>; choose a single delivery path to avoid duplicate requests and parse overhead.
candidates.rationale: The story-020 review found Google Fonts loaded twice, which adds unnecessary network work and can delay first paint. Consolidating on the HTML <link> keeps the dependency visible and prevents the duplication from recurring.

candidates.text: New reusable UI primitives must ship with at least one automated render/state test and be recorded in the project component registry.
candidates.rationale: The review surfaced that the new Button, Input, Tile, and InfoBox components had no tests and were missing from components.md. Adding both prevents silent breakage and keeps the design system documentation in sync with the codebase.
